records.issue_text: packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts:125 — The async forEach callback discards its promise, causing calendar initialization errors, including previously caught synchronous constructor errors, to escape the surrounding try/catch as unhandled rejections.
records.rationale: The diff shows at lines 125 in vital/lib/reschedule.ts and wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts that `bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {` is used. The async callback inside forEach means the promises returned are not awaited - forEach ignores return values. The surrounding try/catch block (visible at line 123) cannot catch exceptions from these async callbacks because they execute asynchronously and their rejections become unhandled promise rejections. This is a real bug where errors in calendar deletion operations will not be properly caught.
